label: B · 批量图片
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Render one high-fidelity PixelForge Chinese desktop product homepage, edge-to-edge, wide desktop aspect ratio, no browser chrome or devices. The attached existing workspace is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: inherit sage off-white surfaces, forest-green ink and actions, precise quiet controls and the PixelForge wordmark; do not copy its composition or text. The actual product converts STATIC images LOCALLY; supports 14 export formats, batch conversion, adjustable quality/size, before-after preview and ZIP download. HEIC is INPUT ONLY. Use these exact simple Chinese words, optimized to remove slogans: heading “在本地转换图片格式”; description “支持 14 种格式导出，可批量调整画质和尺寸。图片无需上传。”; main action “开始转换”; secondary action “试用示例”. Navigation “首页 / 转换工作台 / 格式支持 / 使用指南”. Keep all controls clearly readable, plausible to implement as semantic HTML. NO compression numbers, NO file size numbers, NO percentages, NO testimonials, NO professional-printing or lossless-everywhere claims, NO benefit badge row, NO equal icon-card feature row. Do not substitute the supplied exact heading with a new slogan. A single dominant compositional move, generous whitespace, realistic complete page and the beginning of its lower section. The reference palette and type character stay fixed. COMPOSITION B: An image contact-sheet composition, not a split hero. The central large headline and actual action are embedded in a broad quiet top strip, followed by an asymmetrical photographic contact sheet that spans the viewport: one dominant still-life photograph of a leaf, two smaller landscapes, each with only a filename and corresponding target format. These are explicitly “示例图片”, not user data. A green action bar crossing the lower part of the sheet names “批量转换” with “选择图片” and a simple ZIP download cue. There must be a strong editorial image hierarchy rather than three equal cards. Let image subjects have differing scales and irregular whitespace; preserve the same sage UI identity. At the bottom begin an honest two-column textual section “选好格式，再下载” explaining quality/size adjustment and local processing without icons or big metrics. No file size estimates or savings claims.
